jālahatthapāda.p: [Jāla+hatthapāda] (ti) Google Translate Lace-mesh window-like arms and legs (fingers, toes); Lace - Network - with flat arms and legs (fingers, toes) like a windshield window.
a: ဇာလဟတ္ထပါဒ(တိ)

B:

K:
jālahatthapāda：ဇာလဟတ္ထပါဒ（တိ）
[ဇာလ+ဟတ္ထပါဒ]
ဇာ-ကွန်ရက်-တပ်သော လေသာပြူတင်းနှင့်တူသော လက်，ခြေ （လက်ချောင်း，ခြေချောင်း）ရှိသော၊ ဇာ-ကွန်ရက်-တပ်သောလေသာပြူတင်း ပမာညီညာသော လက်，ခြေ （လက်ချောင်း，ခြေချောင်း）ရှိသော （ဘုရားလောင်း）။
R:
jālahatthapāda：ဇာလ-ဟတ္ထ-ပါဒ （တိ）
ကွန်ရက်နှင့် တူသော လက်ဖဝါး ခြေဖဝါး ရှိသည်။
DOP: 1 jāla n. ( and m., and jālā 1 , f. ?) [ S. jāla, n. ], 1. a net; network; a web ; Abh 521; 948 (~aṃ macchādibandhane); D I 45, 30 (dakkho kevaṭṭo … sukhumacchikena ~ena parittaṃ udakadahaṃ otthareyya); II 183, 7 (ekaṃ ~aṃ sovaṇṇamayaṃ); S I 48, 22* (chetvā maccuno ~aṃ); Dhp 347 (sayaṃkataṃ makkaṭako va ~aṃ); Sn 71 (vāto va ~amhi asajjamāno; Nidd [ Be ] II 302, 10 : dve ~ā, taṇhājālaṃ ca diṭṭhijālaṃ ca); Ja I 208, 30 (upari ~e khitte, Be, Ce, Se so; Ee wr ~aṃ); 209, 15* (sammodamānā gacchanti ~am ādāya pakkhino); II 51, 12 (tattha tattha pāse c’ eva ~āni ca oḍḍāpesi); VI 488, 23 (piṭṭhiyaṃ muttājālaṃ kañcanajālaṃ maṇijālan ti tīṇi ~āni); Ap 516, 8 (pattaṃ … ~ena pidahitvāna); Sp 330, 12 (macchaṃ balisena vā ~ena vā kuminena vā hatthena vā gaṇhāti); Ps III 215, 7 (ratanamaṇḍapamatthake sukhuma-cchiddakaṃ ~aṃ baddhaṃ ahosi, Be, Se so; Ce, Ee jālabandhanaṃ, perhaps wr ); Spk II 228, 18 (rājūnaṃ uparisote ~aṃ pasāretvā gaṅgāya kīḷantānaṃ); Pj II 115, 2 (eko mahāmaccho ~aṃ bhetvā palāyi); Th-a II 129, 22 (taṇhājālo samūhato ti taṇhāsaṅkhāto ~o maggena samugghāṭito); Ap-a 482, 19 (kevaṭṭā taṃ macchaṃ ~ena gahetvā, Ce so; Be, Se ~āya; Ee ~ā); Sadd 563, 17 (jala apavāraṇe: jāleti jālayati ~aṃ); — jālaṃ in Ee, Se at Nidd I 90, 1 is wr for phālaṃ ( Be, Ce so ); — ifc see inda-, kiṅkiṇika- ( sv kiṅkiṇikā ), gavakkha- ( sv gava 1 ), taṇhā-, pabbata-, bhumma-, sirā-; — 2. a (lattice) window ; Abh 216 (~aṃ ca sīhapañjaraṃ); 948; — 3. a collection, a multitude ; Abh 631; 948 (samūhe ca ~aṃ); Sadd 536, 16* ; — jāla in Ee at Ud-a 57, 23 (pañcajāladhajaparivārito) is wr; Be, Se pavāḷadhaja-; Ce pavāla-; — °’- akkhika , n. [jāla + akkhika 4 ], the hole of a net ; Ja I 208, 26 ; — °’- āguṇṭhita , mfn. , covered with a network ;? ( see jālahatthapāda below ); Th-a II 2, 10 (~-mudutalunadīghaṅgulihatthaṃ, Be, Ce, Se so; Ee jālāguṇṭhika-); — °- karaṇḍaka , m. [ cf Jm p. 176, 8 , 15 ], a netted enclosure ; Ja II 104, 18 (tass’ ekadivasaṃ mahānadiyaṃ ~e kīḷantassa); Dhp-a III 199, 14 (seṭṭhī parissayamocanatthaṃ c’ eva pamādena galitānaṃ ābharaṇādīnaṃ rakkhaṇatthaṃ ca ~aṃ parikkhipāpetvā gaṅgāya udakakīḷaṃ kīḷi); — °- kucchi , m. , the inside of a net ; Ja I 427, 18 ; — °- khipanakuminā , m.pl. [jāla + khipana 1 + kumina], nets, traps and baskets ; Sv 789, 23 (~’ādīhi gahitakāle; = Ps I 293, 9 : jālakkhipakuminādīhi); — °- cchiddaka , n. , a hole in a net or network ; Sp 620, 5 (pupphajālaṃ karontassa ekamekamhi ~e dukkaṭaṃ); — °- tambanakha , mfn. , with a network (of lines?) and with copper-coloured nails ;? Vv 81:16 (mudūhi pāṇīhi ~ehi ca, Ce, Ee so; Be, Se jāli-; Vv-a 315, 30 foll. : jālavantehi abhilohitanakhehi, tena jālahatthataṃ mahāpurisalakkhaṇaṃ tambanakhataṃ anuvyañjanaṃ ca dasseti, Be, Ce, Se so; Ee jālihatthataṃ); — °- pacchanna , mfn. , covered by a net ; Th 297 (kāmandhā ~ā, Be, Ce so; Ee, Se °-sañchannā; Th-a II 125, 32 : visattikājālena pakārato channā paliguṇṭhitā, Be, Ce, Ee so; Se samantato channā; = Ud 76, 5* : eds °-sañchannā; quoted Nett 36, 10* : Be, Ce °-sañchannā; Ee °-sacchannā); — °- pūva , m. , a “lattice-cake” ;? Vism 108, 4 (nivāsanapārupanaṃ antacchinnaṃ olamba-vilambasuttakākiṇṇaṃ ~-sadisaṃ; Vism-mhṭ [ Be ] I 129, 15 : jālākārena katapūvaṃ ~aṃ) ≠ Dhp-a I 319, 14 (pubbalohitamakkhitaṃ ~-sadisaṃ, Be, Se so; Ce, Ee -pūpa-); Thūp 251, 17 (ghaṭapakkajālapūve bhattena saddhiṃ niccaṃ dāpesiṃ); — °- bandhanaṃ in Ce, Ee at Ps III 215, 7 is prob. wr; Be, Se jālaṃ baddham); — °- va(t) 1 , mfn. , “netted”, marked with a network of lines ;? Vv-a 315, 30 ([pāṇīhi] °-vantehi abhilohitanakhehi, tena jālahatthataṃ mahāpurisa-lakkhaṇaṃ tambanakhataṃ anuvyañjanaṃ ca dasseti); — °- vātapāna , n. , a lattice window or shutter ; Vin II 148, 29 (anujānāmi bhikkhave tīṇi vātapānāni vedikāvātapānaṃ ~aṃ salākavātapānan ti; Sp 1216, 14 : ~aṃ nāma jālakabandhaṃ); Mil 55, 28 (imesu ~esu ugghāṭitesu); Mp I 451, 10 (~aṃ vivaritvā); — °- vicitta , °-vicitra, mfn. , ornamented with a net (of lines?) ; Ja VI 561, 10´ (~ā hatthapādā, Se so; Be, Ce, Ee kañcanajālavicittā; ad 561, 3* : hatthapādā ca jālino); Vism 40, 6 (~ena hatthena, Ce, Se so; Be, Ee °-vicitrena); — °- saṅkhāta , mfn. and m. , (that) which is called the net ; Th 135 (pahīno ~o; cf Th-a II 14, 8 : sattasantānassa ottharaṇato nissarituṃ appadānato ca ~o ti ca laddhanāmā diṭṭhi avijjā ca pahīnā); Spk I 106, 10 (maccuno ~aṃ kilesajālaṃ chinditvā); — °- hattha , m. and mfn. , 1. ( m. ) a “netted” hand (with a network of lines?) ; Ps II 238, 16 (~ehi … udakaṃ gahetvā); Vv-a 315, 30 (~-taṃ mahāpurisalakkhaṇam, Be, Ce, Se so; Ee jālihatthataṃ); — 2. ( mfn. ) with net(s) in hand ; Ja I 234, 19 (kulasahassaṃ ~aṃ … macche pariyesantaṃ); — °- hatthapāda , mfn. , with “netted” hands and feet, prob. with hands and feet marked with a network of lines (one of the 32 marks of a mahāpurisa ) ; D II 17, 23 (ayaṃ hi deva kumāro ~o; cf Sv 446, 21 foll. : na cammena paṭinaddha-aṅgulantaro … mahāpurisassa pana catasso hatthaṅguliyo pañcapādaṅguliyo ekappamāṇā honti … jālalakkhaṇaṃ aññamaññaṃ paṭivijjhitvā tiṭṭhati, ath’ assa hatthapādā kusalena vaḍḍhakinā yojitajālavātapānasadisā honti; Ce, Ee so; Be, Se yava lakkhaṇaṃ); M II 136, 13 (~o kho pana so bhavaṃ Gotamo); — sajāla , mfn. , with lattice-work ; Mp II 238, 19 (dvāravātapānāni … savivarāni ~āni ahesuṃ); — see also antojālagata, antojālī̆kata ( sv anto ), indajālika ( sv inda ).
